title: The Pretend Play Christmas Gift Guide for Little Girls
description: Pretend play Christmas gifts for little girls, all from Sam's Club: a Member's Mark supermarket playset, a wooden mixer and baking set, a Casdon Dyson toy vacuum and styling set, a doll stroller, a weighted baby doll and a pink plush pet carrier.
intro: Little girls don't want to play pretend. They want to play grown-up, with the real-looking stuff. So this list is all the good pretend play gifts in one place: a whole wooden supermarket with a self-checkout, a mixer that actually spins, a tiny Dyson vacuum and hair dryer set, a doll stroller, a baby doll with her own birth certificate, and a pink puppy in a carrier backpack. Christmas morning is going to be loud. In a good way.

sections.heading: The big one
paragraphs: The Member's Mark Supermarket Playset: wood shelves stocked with pretend groceries, a self-checkout with a scanner and card reader, a basket and a little shopping bag. It's the gift that takes over the corner of the room.

sections.heading: The grown-up copycats
paragraphs: The Member's Mark Wooden Mixer and Baking Playset, and the Casdon Dyson Cordless Vacuum Cleaner and Supersonic Kids Styling Set with its toy stick vacuum, pink hair dryer, attachments, round brush and comb.

sections.heading: The doll stuff
paragraphs: The Member's Mark 2-in-1 Deluxe Baby Doll Stroller with its aqua bassinet, the Member's Mark Purely Perfect 15.5-inch Soft Weighted Realistic Baby Doll with her blanket, bow, pacifier, bib and birth certificate, and the Member's Mark Plush Pet Carrier Backpack in pink and teal with a puppy inside.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The tree, the wrapping paper, the rooms and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
